name: Cognitive Load Theory
axiom: Interaction suffers when extraneous cognitive demands consume the working memory a task needs.
trigger: People re-read instructions, hunt for guidance, or make avoidable errors in a dense single-page form.

checklist.text: Remove decoration, redundant banners, and instructions that repeat the visible label.
Reveal secondary detail only when the current step needs it.
Put guidance beside the field it explains instead of on a separate help page.

antiPattern.violation: A tax form presents 100 fields on one scrolling page, each preceded by paragraphs of legal text.
antiPattern.remediation: Split filing into focused steps and move legal detail into inline popovers.

parametricParams.caption: LOAD PAST CAPACITY COSTS THE TASK
